label: Road Ahead
description: One ride field: the elevation profile of the road in front of you, with no route loaded. It guesses the road ahead from the one you're on, reads the roads from the Karoo's own offline map, and fetches elevation over Wi-Fi. Tap the field to step between 2, 5 and 10 km.
releaseNotes: Roundabouts mapped in pieces. Many roundabouts are mapped as several pieces, one between each pair of roads that meet them, and the Karoo's map doesn't say they are roundabouts. The picture could stop there with nothing ahead. It now joins the pieces and goes round to the likeliest exit.
